exercisePermission.title: Turn on workout tracking
exercisePermission.body: POWR can see your steps but not your workouts. Allow workout access to earn points for runs, rides and more.

workoutsMissing.title: Missing your workouts?
workoutsMissing.bodyAndroid: Your wearable is logging activity, but workouts aren’t coming through. In Garmin Connect → Settings → Health Connect, turn on Activities.
workoutsMissing.bodyIos: Your wearable is logging activity, but POWR can’t see your workouts. Enable Workouts for POWR in Apple Health.

setupHealth.title: Check-ins aren’t running
setupHealth.bodyGym: POWR tried to check you in from your pocket and couldn’t — background location is switched off, so gym trips with the app closed earn nothing.
setupHealth.bodyVenue: POWR tried to check you in from your pocket and couldn’t — background location is switched off, so visits to partner venues with the app closed earn nothing.

body.reconnectIos: Apple Health is no longer sharing with POWR — its permissions can switch off after a reinstall or update. Your phone is still counting every step; POWR just can't see them. Reconnect and today's walking starts earning again.
body.reconnectAndroid: Health Connect is no longer sharing with POWR — its permissions can switch off after a reinstall or update. Your phone is still counting every step; POWR just can't see them. Reconnect and today's walking starts earning again.
body.settingsIos: POWR needs read access in Apple Health to count your steps. Flip it on in the Health app and this picks up right where you left off.
body.settingsAndroid: POWR needs read access in Health Connect to count your steps. Flip it on in Health Connect and this picks up right where you left off.
body.connectIos: Your phone already counts every step you take. Connect Apple Health and they turn into POWR points automatically — no logging, no check-ins, just walking.
body.connectAndroid: Your phone already counts every step you take. Connect Health Connect and they turn into POWR points automatically — no logging, no check-ins, just walking.

body.venueAsk: POWR can see you’re at {{venue}} only because the app is open. On “While Using” it can’t check you in from your pocket — set it to {{always}} and every visit counts, starting with this one.
body.venueSettings: Set POWR’s location to {{always}} in Settings and it’ll check you in at {{venue}} automatically — even with the app closed.
body.askGym: POWR can only check you in from your pocket on {{always}}. Right now it’s set to “While Using”, so every trip to the gym with the app closed is earning you nothing.
body.askVenue: POWR can only check you in from your pocket on {{always}}. Right now it’s set to “While Using”, so every visit to a partner venue with the app closed is earning you nothing.
body.settings: Set POWR’s location to {{always}} in Settings and it’ll check you in automatically — even with the app closed.

notificationPrime.headline:
Earning in
<gold>silence.</gold>
notificationPrime.bodyAsk: You’ve banked sessions with alerts off — every payout landed without a sound. Turn them on and know the second a session counts, a streak’s saved or a reward drops.
notificationPrime.bodyDenied: Notifications are switched off for POWR at the system level. Flip them on in Settings and never find out late again.

levelUp.apex: Top of the mountain. Nothing left to unlock.

transfer.headline:
Bring POWR
<gold>to this phone.</gold>
transfer.body: Your POWR account is set up on {{device}}. Move it here to keep earning — {{device}} will be signed out. Only one phone at a time.
transfer.bodyLastSeen: Your POWR account is set up on {{device}} (last active {{when}}). Move it here to keep earning — {{device}} will be signed out. Only one phone at a time.

crash.headline: That didn’t load.
crash.body: The problem was recorded and sent to us. Your points and your streak are untouched.
crash.terminal: Close POWR and open it again.
crash.caption: Still stuck? Close POWR and open it again.

friendPulse.subBonus: Take on a challenge together — finish it and you both earn +{{bonus}} on top.

outcome.expiredSolo: Time ran out — you didn’t finish
outcome.lostPooled: The group hit the target without you
outcome.lost: Time’s up — you didn’t finish this one

subtitle.solo: You finished — bonus grows as friends finish
